notes.title: Spring Sale & Exciting News: New Games, Hidden Cats, and Cozy Puzzle Adventures!
notes.content:
Hello, dear Hidden Cat Memories adventurers!

Your support for Hidden Cat Memories has been amazing! We love seeing your enthusiasm as you uncover the secrets and stories of our feline-filled world. Your reviews and excitement inspire us to keep creating cozy, hidden-object experiences for you to enjoy.

[h2]Spring Sale is Here![/h2]

The Steam Spring Sale is here, and it’s the perfect time to expand your hidden cat collection! Our Gemcraft’s Hidden Cat Bundle is on sale with a huge discount, featuring Hidden Cat Memories, Kittenwood, and Kittenbay. If you haven’t completed your collection, now’s your chance!

store.steampowered.com/bundle/43994/Gemcrafts_Hidden_Cat_Bundle/

[h2]Announcing Déjà View - A Spot The Difference Game (Q2 2025)[/h2]

We’re excited to share that Déjà View - A Spot The Difference Game is launching in Q2 2025! Created with original artwork by Bleeding Moon Studio, this game is a fresh, engaging experience for puzzle lovers. While it’s different from our hidden object games, it carries the same level of charm and artistic detail that you love.

Make sure to wishlist it now to stay updated!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3581940/Deja_View__A_Spot_The_Difference_Game

[h2]Mermeows - Chill Cat Mermaids Arriving Late Q4 2025![/h2]

A cozy and relaxing new experience is on the way! Mermeows - Chill Cat Mermaids is set to launch in late Q4 2025. Care for adorable cat mermaids, build beautiful pond sanctuaries, and enjoy a heartwarming, stress-free adventure.

Your wishlist helps us bring Mermeows to life and reach more players!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3457460/Mermeows_Chill_Cat_Mermaids/

[h2]More Hidden Cat Games in the Works![/h2]

We’re also working on two new hidden cat games! They are still in early development, so while we don’t have a release date just yet, more feline adventures are on the horizon. We’ll share updates as soon as we can!

[h2]We’d Love to Hear From You![/h2]

If you’ve enjoyed Hidden Cat Memories, leaving a review would mean the world to us! Your feedback helps us improve and brings our games to new players who love cozy hidden object adventures.

Thank you for being a part of our journey. 

Happy gaming,
The Gemcraft Games Team
